scientific_integrity: Theorem proved analytically for all integer M>=2 and n>=1; finite exact integer tests check monomial algebra, histogram and extremal multiplicities but are not exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed points of iterates, not exclusively least-period points, are counted in histograms; witnesses for sharp minima have least period n. No assertion concerning singular values, arbitrary cocycles, or full typical-orbit Lyapunov distributions. Equivalent uncatalogued computations may exist.
title: Prime-divisor onset and exact weakest-multiplier census for the twisted baker map
